title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to note the records that the user has selected on the Subpage/Lines (Page.SetSelectionFilter in part)
summary: Page.SetSelectionFilter is a method that captures records selected by users on pages or subpages, marks them in the table, and applies a filter. The post explains how to use it both on main pages by accessing subpages via CurrPage and directly on subpage extensions.
key_points: Page.SetSelectionFilter(var Record) gets user-selected records and applies a 'marked only' filter
On main pages, access subpage selections using CurrPage.{SubpageName}.Page.SetSelectionFilter()
On subpage extensions, use CurrPage.SetSelectionFilter() directly like normal page usage
The method marks selected records in the specified table for processing

quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the exact syntax for accessing selections on a subpage from the main page, a key practical technique
